Regarding the Reel example I included from Instagram: this content format is very intentional. If you look through this creator’s account, you’ll notice many of her Reels follow the exact same structure: long list-style text in white font over darkened footage that moves too quickly to comfortably read in one viewing.

Part of the strategy behind this is increasing watch time and replays. Viewers pause, rewatch, or stay on the Reel longer trying to read everything, which  signals strong watch time and engagement to Instagram. In that sense, this format is a bit of a “system hack,” and it’s something some coaches intentionally teach as a growth tactic.

I think this style works best when there’s a balance between strategy and viewer experience. You want people engaged and interested, but you also want the content to still feel valuable and enjoyable to consume.

You’re  welcome to experiment with this format if it fits your brand or content style.
